workflow: Production cad-core creates the A3 layout and two viewport transactions, serializes KDRAW1, deletes the clipped viewport, undoes and redoes it, then serializes again. A separate reader validates magic, envelope, payload length, document SHA-256 and manifest checksum before parsing document.json without calling deserializeKDraw.
result: The independent reader recovered stable viewport-1 and viewport-2 IDs, exact disjoint frames, view centers 0 and 2000, the six-point polygon clip, revision 2 multiple-view state, adjacent selection after delete, exact two/one viewport undo-redo sequence and final revision 5 one-viewport state.
